prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: subtle photographic homepage image, 1536 x 1024 landscape, 3:2.

Image 1 is the ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH and definitive source of the actual person, his face, hair, expression, body, pose, hands and guitar. Base this image directly on that photograph. Image 2 is ONLY a placement guide for the website: the person on the right, empty dark space on the left. Do not copy image 2's drawing style, altered hair, altered facial anatomy or textured skin.

Create a quiet, sensitively treated monochrome photographic portrait of this exact Jackie Leven, seated at his microphone, absorbed in playing his acoustic guitar. Preserve the photograph's characteristic full face, rounded cheeks and heavy soft chin, softly closed/downcast eyes, subtle mouth shape, slightly lowered head pointing toward viewer left, natural wavy swept-back hair with the hairline and volume from the original photo, broad substantial torso, both forearms, both hands playing the guitar and the foreshortened guitar neck. Preserve age, asymmetries, bodily weight and unidealized likeness. Retain the simple shirt and rolled sleeves. Avoid reconstruction into a different handsome person.

Rendering should be about 90% natural black-and-white photography and 10% extremely restrained artistic softness. Continuous, delicate photographic tonal gradients, believable gentle skin texture and hair detail, softly resolved cloth and wood, a trace of fine analog grain. Soft matte photographic print quality, intimate and human. No ink strokes, crosshatching, scratchy edges, impasto, stippling, posterized face, coarse paper, artificial oil-paint texture, hard sharpening, waxy skin or digital smoothing. Facial features should not become more dramatic or severe than the source.

Recompose into a dark open space: Jackie occupies the RIGHT 58–60% of the landscape, his head approximately x=76%, y=27%, keeping the entire head, both hands and most of the guitar inside the frame. LEFT 40–43% is empty almost-black anthracite #0d0f12 for real HTML text to be overlaid later; do not include any lettering. The musician floats visually in this open darkness with no ground or visible chair. There must be no bright rectangular photo background, no room, no stage, no tent. Remove lanyard/badge, background equipment, spare stands and loose cables. Retain only the quiet microphone near his mouth and a fine subdued portion of its support. No glowing outline or theatrical halo.

Light the face, hands and guitar softly with muted mid-grey highlights; retain detail without hard contrast. Keep a natural positive photographic tonal structure. Neutral greys, no sepia/brown/cream/blue tint. Let the shirt, outer silhouette and lower guitar fade very gently and irregularly into #0d0f12; subtle lost edges and natural shadows, not a visible oval vignette or painted brush border. Background seamlessly dark at all outer edges, especially all of the left side. The transition should be atmospheric yet clean, with no smoke or fog. The face and hands retain enough presence to be recognised instantly. No text, watermark, logo or border.
